reviews.title: Ffs … HOW MUCH? For THAT?
reviews.text: So sick of apps that are nothing but a waste of time to download… Dude… it’s just a photo file adjacent a video file treated like they’re a singular file … like they don’t even bother … u charge like you did something

reviews.title: Live Photo can’t be iPhone Background
reviews.text: I created a photo that my iPhone says is live but when attempting to set it as my background it says the live is not supported. Additionally, the photo quality was noticeably reduced in the pseudo live file it gave me.
